messages:
oliver: Trying the Go quickstart sample for the first time. App starts but first API call returns 502 intermittently, sometimes 403. very confusing. anyone seen mixed 502/403 on first-run?

maya: 502 then 403 on first call is usually either (a) sample app hitting wrong endpoint, (b) transient infra during provisioning, or (c) billing gating + client retry masking the real status. can you paste logs/snippet?

oliver: docker logs snippet:
```
[2026-01-15T10:01:02Z] ERROR outbound request failed status=502 body="bad gateway"
[2026-01-15T10:01:03Z] RETRY -> status=403 body={"detail":"workspace requires billing"}
```
app run cmd: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$KEY -p 8080:8080 redwood/quickstart-go:stable`

infra-bot: Service deploy for quickstart-images is still warming up in region-us-west-2; proxy may return transient 502s for new images.

billing-bot: Org 'oliver-team' has no active billing profile. Hosted API calls will be blocked until a billing method is added.

maya: ok two signals here: the platform transient 502 from a cold deploy, and the billing 403. The quickstart retry logic in some SDKs retries on 5xx and then surfaces the later 4xx which confuses the end user.

oliver: that explains it. so if the SDK retries a 502 then gets a 403 on retry, the user sees only the 403 and assumes billing, but the real problem was the deploy flapping? feels noisy.

harper: We intentionally retry 5xx, but not 4xx. Bug is some SDKs coalesce errors and return the last error without context. The Node/Go SDKs added a header X-Redwood-Retries that can help. For quickstart we should show both statuses.

maya: workaround for now: (1) ensure billing profile is present for the org so 403 won't appear, (2) wait ~30s for quickstart image to warm or use `--no-retry` flag in the sample client to see raw error, e.g.:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), Retries: 0})
```

oliver: i added billing profile and retried after 1m. still saw a single 502 once, then success. after setting billing the error stream is clearer.

docs: We should update quickstart README to: (a) call out required billing/profile for hosted API access, (b) show how to disable retries in the sample to debug first-call errors, and (c) mention potential ~1min warmup for new quickstart images.

maya: also a small SDK improvement: include an error_summary field when returning a retried request, e.g. "attempts: [502, 403]" so apps can surface full history. Filing an SDK ticket.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-7009 (quickstart image warmup), SDK-7010 (error history in retry responses), DOCS-7011 (README updates).

oliver: one UX note: the console shows billing banner but it's easy to miss when you're following a sample. maybe show a modal on empty orgs or add a CLI hint when `redwood quickstart run` sees 403.

harper: agreed, adding a CLI hint is low-effort. will add detection: if first call returns 403 and org has no billing, print: "Billing required: run `redwood billing setup` or add a payment method in the console".

oliver: thanks everyone, fixed now and first call succeeded after warmup. closing once PRs land. :white_check_mark:
